method: Visual reading of original chart at actual airflow and equivalent circular diameter; broad ranges reflect printed line thickness and interpolation between diameter curves. This is an independent graphical check, not exact digitisation.
version_note: Workshop refers to 2013 Figure 10; the corresponding chart is Figure 9 in the downloaded 2021 chapter. Both state density 1.20 kg/m3 and roughness 0.09 mm.
result: All four computed gradients are consistent with visual chart ranges. Exact sizing uses the independently validated correlation; chart precision alone is insufficient to certify an exact 0.8 Pa/m boundary.
